title: Test 20 — Autofocus and show the plot of the z-axis where the focus plane is found
agent_prompt: The current sample is out of the focal plane. Try to locate the focal plane of the image using the brightfield channel. Plot the tested z-axis positions vs. the focus metric and highlight the value at which the focal plane was found. Take an image at the best z-position and display it in the napari GUI. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: Image of the sample in focus
Plot of z-axis positions vs. focus metric
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
